tuik.title: Milletvekili Genel Seçimleri, 1923-2011
tuik.note: TÜİK publication 3685, June 2012, hosted by YSK. The Dönem table gives polling days for the 9th to 24th terms. Table 3 gives total seats per election. Constituency counts are from the narrative (Açıklama section). The 1954 narrative says 542 seats, but Table 3 says 541; Table 3 is used. Province-level data for 1946 is not available per the text.

ysk2023.title: 14 Mayıs 2023 Cumhurbaşkanı ve 28. Dönem Milletvekili Genel Seçimleri İstatistikleri
ysk2023.note: Section 2.6 gives seats per province for 2018 and 2023 (TOPLAM 600 in both). Section 4.3.3 is the constituency table for 2023: 87 rows, with 81 provinces and Ankara, Bursa, İstanbul, and İzmir split into 3, 2, 3, and 2 constituencies. The Kahramanmaraş row shows 5 in its İL TOPLAM cell, but its party cells and section 2.6 both give 8; 8 is used, and the column then sums to 600.

elections.note: TÜİK says province-level results for 1946 are not available, so the number of constituencies (provinces) is not stated.

elections.quote: Table 3, row 1950: Toplam milletvekili sayısı 487; Dönem table: 9.Dönem 14 Mayıs 1950
elections.note: Before 1983 TÜİK says each province was one constituency, but the province count is not stated in the text, and the per-province tables did not reconcile with the published totals, so it is left null.
